_comment: Trigger vocabulary for the deterministic who-am-i classifier. Language data only -- no logic. Add more phrasings/languages here without touching whoami_classifier.py. Unlike greeting_phrases.json (whole-message, per-token match), these are whole-message, whole-phrase matches -- 'who am i' is a phrase, not a set of independently meaningful tokens. This is a known interim measure, not the end state: it can only ever catch phrasings someone thought to add here. Broader, AI-understood identity questions are the acknowledged future direction (flagged explicitly, not forgotten) -- deferred for now because it costs the same AI call as any other understood message, versus this list's zero cost.
whoami: which company do i belong to
